summary: Motorsport Games Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing that its reconvened 2026 Annual Meeting on April 21, 2026 lacked a quorum and was adjourned to April 23, 2026. No business was conducted; the record date remains February 27, 2026. The company continues soliciting proxies for proposals in its March 16, 2026 proxy statement. This is a routine procedural adjournment due to insufficient shareholder turnout, not a special situation event like a contested meeting or activist campaign.
